name: Threat Hunting Lab (Python + Jupyter)
onCreateCommand: python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -U pip && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
postCreateCommand: . .venv/bin/activate && python -m ipykernel install --user --name threat-hunting-lab --display-name "Python (Threat Hunting Lab)"
